name: nullTestReturnsTrue
expected: Returns true because a null test matches any node without filtering.

name: nodeNameTestNonElementNodeReturnsFalse
input: node = Text node, test = NodeNameTest (matching name)
expected: Returns false because NodeNameTest requires node type to be Node.ELEMENT_NODE.

name: nodeNameTestWildcardNoPrefixReturnsTrue
input: node = Element, test = NodeNameTest with wildcard=true and testPrefix=null
expected: Returns true because a wildcard test with no prefix matches any element node.

name: nodeNameTestWildcardWithNamespaceMatching
input: node = Element with specific namespace URI, test = NodeNameTest with wildcard=true and namespaceURI matching nodeNS
expected: Returns true because wildcard matches the local name and equalStrings validates namespace URI.

name: nodeNameTestLocalNameAndNamespaceMatch
input: node = Element (local name 'foo', namespace 'http://ns'), test = NodeNameTest for 'foo' with namespace 'http://ns'
expected: Returns true because both local name and namespace URI match successfully.

name: nodeNameTestLocalNameMatchNamespaceMismatch
input: node = Element (local name 'foo', namespace 'http://ns1'), test = NodeNameTest for 'foo' with namespace 'http://ns2'
expected: Returns false because namespace URIs do not match according to equalStrings.

name: nodeNameTestLocalNameMismatch
input: node = Element (local name 'bar'), test = NodeNameTest for 'foo'
expected: Returns false because local names do not match.

name: nodeTypeTestNodeNodeTypeElement
input: node = Element node, test = NodeTypeTest with type Compiler.NODE_TYPE_NODE
expected: Returns true because NODE_TYPE_NODE matches ELEMENT_NODE.

name: nodeTypeTestNodeNodeTypeDocument
input: node = Document node, test = NodeTypeTest with type Compiler.NODE_TYPE_NODE
expected: Returns true because NODE_TYPE_NODE matches DOCUMENT_NODE.

name: nodeTypeTestNodeNodeTypeInvalidType
input: node = Comment node, test = NodeTypeTest with type Compiler.NODE_TYPE_NODE
expected: Returns false because COMMENT_NODE is not matched by NODE_TYPE_NODE.

name: nodeTypeTestTextNodeText
input: node = Text node, test = NodeTypeTest with type Compiler.NODE_TYPE_TEXT
expected: Returns true because NODE_TYPE_TEXT matches TEXT_NODE.

name: nodeTypeTestTextNodeCdata
input: node = CDATASection node, test = NodeTypeTest with type Compiler.NODE_TYPE_TEXT
expected: Returns true because NODE_TYPE_TEXT matches CDATA_SECTION_NODE.

name: nodeTypeTestCommentNode
input: node = Comment node, test = NodeTypeTest with type Compiler.NODE_TYPE_COMMENT
expected: Returns true because NODE_TYPE_COMMENT matches COMMENT_NODE.

name: nodeTypeTestPiNode
input: node = ProcessingInstruction node, test = NodeTypeTest with type Compiler.NODE_TYPE_PI
expected: Returns true because NODE_TYPE_PI matches PROCESSING_INSTRUCTION_NODE.

name: nodeTypeTestUnknownCompilerType
input: node = Element node, test = NodeTypeTest with an unrecognized node type int
expected: Returns false because the switch statement does not match any known case and falls through to return false.

name: processingInstructionTestMatchingTarget
input: node = ProcessingInstruction with target 'target1', test = ProcessingInstructionTest with target 'target1'
expected: Returns true because instruction targets match exactly.

name: processingInstructionTestNonPiNodeReturnsFalse
expected: Returns false because node type is not PROCESSING_INSTRUCTION_NODE.

name: processingInstructionTestTargetMismatch
input: node = ProcessingInstruction with target 'target1', test = ProcessingInstructionTest with target 'target2'
expected: Returns false because targets do not match.

name: unknownTestImplementationReturnsFalse
input: node = Element node, test = custom/unknown subclass of NodeTest
expected: Returns false because none of the supported NodeTest subclasses match.
